simple.summary: מֵשָׁא (Mêshâʼ) means Mesha , a place in Arabia First listed occurrence: Gen 10 30.

definitions.full: H4852. Mesha מֵשָׁא proper name, of a location limiting territory of Joktanites , Gen 10:30 ; Dl Par 243 identifies with Assyrian Maš (Syro-Arabic desert); > district Mesene , on Persian Gulf, Thes 823 (compare Di); ᵐ5 Μασση ( ε ), whence Di I. מַשָּׂא q. v. (after Hal Mél.91 f. ) [ מַשְׂאָב ] see שׂאב . מְשׁאָה see מְשׂוֺאָה . מַשֻּׁאוֺת מַשָּׁאוֺן, see II. נשׁא .
